shorts.headline: A week from countdown to a clean launch
shorts.caption: The countdown learned to wait on Wednesday; on Thursday the rocket launched on the first try and shipped v1.0.0.

fields.title: A week from countdown to a clean launch
fields.dek: The countdown learned to wait on Wednesday; on Thursday the rocket launched on the first try and shipped v1.0.0.

shorts.headline: 4 changes and a launch
shorts.caption: The rocket shipped v1.0.0 after four changes.

shorts.headline: From countdown to liftoff, without a scrub
shorts.caption: Two fixes on the way up: the spark retries, and the pad waits for the gyro.

shorts.headline: The pad waits for the gyro before it lets go
shorts.caption: Clamps stay closed until guidance is steady, so a wobble scrubs nothing.

shorts.headline: A missed spark gets a second try
shorts.caption: The engine asks for a spark again when the first one misses.

shorts.headline: Boosters are called stages now
shorts.caption: The word changes everywhere; nothing else does.
